version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Windows: libusb + hidapi now live in UserPlugins alongside reaper_rea-sixty.dll (delay-load + AddDllDirectory). No more manual placement next to reaper.exe. Linux: udev rule installer button in Settings -> About (one pkexec prompt, same UX as the Windows WinUSB-installer). ReaPack support for all three platforms.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Device pane: three new toggles under Settings -> Device -- TCP follows UF8 selection, Show tracks hidden in TCP, Show tracks hidden in MCP (mirror REAPER's panel visibility), and Don't show offline FX (skipped by every cycle ring + the UF8 colour-bar default cursor).
SEL-Mode polish: leaving Auto SEL mode now scrolls the UF8 bank so the selected track is in view again, mirrored on Selection Set deactivation. Auto exit also reverts selset auto-arming back to Trim/Read when the Selection-Set auto-mode dropdown is engaged.
Selset activation snaps the bank to the first channel of the set so larger sets start at strip 0.
Bug fix: FX/Instance Cycle dispatch swap in reasixty_dispatchSelModeCycle. With "UF8 Ch. Encoder drives Sel-Mode cycle" enabled, Instance Cycle was routing to the FX-Cycle handler and vice versa.
UF8 colour-bar follows the Channel-Encoder FX Cycle cursor through ReaEQ, ReaComp, etc. -- previously stayed pinned to the focused-domain Instance label on non-Instance landings.
UC1 carousel now shows the lone plug-in name when only one cycle target exists (or only one online target with hide-offline enabled).
Settings reorganisation: every Device control lives in the sidebar Device pane. The orphan "Device" sub-tab under Modes is gone -- its two checkboxes moved to the main Device pane. UC1 GR calibration relocated to the very bottom.
User-renamed FX instances now win over hardcoded displayShort everywhere -- primarily SSL 360 Link, where the "Link" / "L-BC" abbreviation hid what the wrapped plug-in actually was.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Track-name abbreviation modes -- Settings -> Device -> Tracks adds a "Long track-name handling" combo. Default Truncate keeps the legacy 7-char cut. Smart abbreviate drops separators, then vowels after the first letter of each token, then collapses repeated consonants, then distributes the remaining char budget proportionally across tokens (short all-caps tokens like DI / FX / EQ survive). "Background Vocals" -> "BckgVcl", "Drums Bus" -> "DrmsBs". Mode switch repaints all 8 strips immediately.
Reverse LED per Solo / Cut / Sel binding (FX Learn editor right-click) -- for plug-ins whose Cut/Bypass param reports 1 = inactive. Render layer XORs the LED on/off bit. Persisted per (fader-bank, strip, button).
Plugin Mode + This-Track Sends/Receives now keep all 8 strips addressable even when fewer than 8 REAPER tracks are visible. Strips past the bank-track count source content from the focused FX (PM) or route target (sends) instead of going blank.
Fill sequential (right) in the FX Learn editor carries source-strip attributes onto every filled strip: faderInverted, V-Pot inverted/vpotMode/defaultNorm/stripColour, and Solo / Cut / Sel colour + Reverse LED flag. A CS-row fill no longer needs per-strip touch-ups.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Use REAPERAPI_MINIMAL so the plugin loads on REAPER older than the SDK pin Static-link the MSVC runtime on Windows (no VC++ Redistributable required) Pin macOS deployment target to 11.0 (Big Sur) for arm64 + older Intel coverage Fix stereo monitoring: skip balpan on stereo inputs, enforce B_MAINSEND every tick

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Add Toggle 2-Way Control — TotalMix fader/balpan moves now drive the matching REAPER track volume/pan (and direct send vol/pan) when enabled alongside the Routing Mirror. Echo-suppression keeps the loop stable. Add Toggle Auto-Talkback on Stop — drives /controlroom/talkback from REAPER's transport: stop/pause opens talkback, play/record closes it. Toggling on while stopped opens immediately; toggling off closes it. Replace single-slot snapshot save/load with one action per TotalMix snapshot slot (Save/Load TotalMix Snapshot Slot 1…8) so each slot can have its own keybinding. Remove Send Test Mute Input 1 (superseded by Toggle OSC Dump for sanity checking)

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog: Fix 2-Way Control snapping REAPER faders to -inf when Routing Mirror is toggled on. /sendall was firing before the REAPER→TotalMix push completed, so the empty TotalMix state came back and 2-Way wrote it into REAPER. Push now happens first; a brief priming window after push absorbs /sendall echoes without disturbing track state.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
2-way mirror /input/<n>/{48v,pad,phase,gain} into track P_EXT (P_EXT:totalreaper_48v / pad / phase / gain) so any control surface or ReaScript watching the cache reflects direct changes the user makes in TotalMix's UI within one tick, not just after a REAPER-side action. Always-on regardless of 2-Way Control because preamp readbacks are metadata, not routing state.
DumpOsc toggle confirmation now logs to console in release builds — debugLog() was a no-op when NDEBUG is defined, so turning the dump on or off gave no visible feedback in shipped binaries.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Routing mirror: the source track's REAPER pan is now composed into every walked HW-routed bus, not just the main monitor. Headphone cues and other downstream HW outs follow the REAPER pan instead of staying centred.
Routing mirror: clear the per-bus send-routing cache when a track's I_RECINPUT is reassigned. Without the wipe, the new input's matrix cells on every walked bus stayed at -inf until something else perturbed the state — phones now follow input-channel changes immediately, no rec-arm toggle required.
README: document the "Receive to hidden channels" requirement in TotalMix's OSC Details settings. Without it TotalMix silently drops `/mix/in/<n>/<bus>/fader` writes for any channel not in the current layout — the routing mirror appears completely dead even though TotalReaper is sending correctly.

version.author: Frank Acklin
version.changelog:
Routing mirror: only one REAPER track per hardware input now drives the TotalMix matrix cells (the first rec-armed + monitoring track, falling back to the first monitor-only track). Previously every monitoring track that shared an input pushed its own gain values, producing visible fader jitter during slow send moves and breaking mute semantics: send-mute and channel-mute didn't reach TotalMix because other tracks' non-∞ writes overwrote the -∞ close-out within the same Run() tick.
Routing mirror: channel-mute (REAPER track B_MUTE) now drives the owned matrix cells to -∞ on every walked bus, matching the behaviour of monitor-off.
Routing mirror: tick-level TX dedupe — each Run() tick now emits at most one /mix/in/<hwIdx>/<bus>/fader and /balpan per cell. Fixes rapid-fire 4-5 writes per cell per tick that landed during fader moves with multiple tracks on the same input.
Toggle OSC Dump: now also logs outgoing (TX) messages, not just incoming (RX). Used to surface the duplicate-push pattern that motivated the dedupe and primary-owner fix.
Routing mirror: the source track's REAPER pan is now composed into every walked HW-routed bus, not just the main monitor. Headphone cues and other downstream HW outs follow the REAPER pan instead of staying centred.
Routing mirror: clear the per-bus send-routing cache when a track's I_RECINPUT is reassigned. Without the wipe, the new input's matrix cells on every walked bus stayed at -inf until something else perturbed the state — phones now follow input-channel changes immediately, no rec-arm toggle required.
README: document the "Receive to hidden channels" requirement in TotalMix's OSC Details settings. Without it TotalMix silently drops `/mix/in/<n>/<bus>/fader` writes for any channel not in the current layout — the routing mirror appears completely dead even though TotalReaper is sending correctly.
